# Mandatory Rules

- GitHub Issue, repository history, branch and PR provide traceability.
- Work from the locked immutable Skill release; upgrades are explicit.
- Material work requires read-only discovery, a written plan and human approval.
- Production deploys/writes and destructive changes require separate explicit authorization.
- Do not expose or centralize secrets, customer data or customer-specific rules.
- Preserve existing instructions and stricter repository or organization controls.
- Verification, handoff, rollback and learning review are required before PR readiness.
